record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: For a simple vertex operator algebra V satisfying V(0)=C1, V(n)=0 for n<0, V' equivalent to V, and C2-cofiniteness, can genus-zero and genus-one full logarithmic conformal-field-theory correlation functions be constructed from the corresponding chiral correlation functions? Can those correlation functions produce a conformal field theory satisfying the Kontsevich-Segal axioms except for unitarity?

evidence.quote: The associativity of logarithmic intertwining operators and the modular invariance of logarithmic intertwining operators discussed above gave the genus-zero and genus-one chiral correlation functions in the corresponding logarithmic conformal field theory. But we do not know how to construct the genus-zero and genus-one full correlation functions for the logarithmic full conformal field theory.

Problem 5.3. For a vertex operator algebra satisfying the conditions in Conjecture 5.1, is it possible to construct genus-zero and genus-one full correlation functions from the genus-zero and genus-one chiral correlation functions? From these genus-zero and genus-one correlation functions, is it possible to construct a conformal field theory satisfying the axioms of Kontsevich-Segal, except for the axioms involving unitarity?

artifact.status_search_result: The construction of genus-zero and genus-one full (non-chiral) logarithmic correlation functions from the chiral ones, and the corresponding Kontsevich–Segal-type non-unitary CFT, appears to remain open. Progress is restricted to the chiral side: associativity of logarithmic intertwining operators and modular invariance (Huang, Fiordalisi) yield genus-zero and genus-one chiral correlation functions, but no construction of the full logarithmic correlation functions or of a Kontsevich–Segal CFT (minus unitarity) has been reported.

status_evidence.title: Modular Invariance of (Logarithmic) Intertwining Operators, Commun. Math. Phys.
status_evidence.snippet: Modular invariance result gives a construction of C_2-cofinite genus-one logarithmic conformal field theories from the corresponding genus-zero logarithmic conformal field theories.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress addresses only the chiral genus-one case, not full correlation functions.
